articles.title: New Zealand and French studies call attention to Campylobacter
articles.description: A study in New Zealand has provided an insight into Campylobacter contamination and antimicrobial resistance in fresh chicken. Campylobacter was detected in 50 percent of 24 samples. Among confirmed isolates, there were high levels of resistance to tetracycline and ciprofloxacin, while the majority were susceptible to erythromycin.

articles.title: Public health officials investigating Salmonella outbreak in Utah
articles.description: The Bear River Health Department announced today  that it is investigating a Salmonella outbreak after identifying 21 confirmed cases in Cache and Box Elder Counties in northern Utah.  The department says it is actively investigating the source of the illness and taking steps to limit further spread.
